name: cysteine + ribose, 145 C / 20 min, pH 5.0 (the sulfur lane's best-measured point)
_why: 145 C for 20 min at pH 5.0 in water is the condition of the Hofmann & Schieberle 1998 stable-isotope-dilution rows, which are the sulfur branch's only primary-source-verified absolute anchors. It is also where the kinetic core scores its best out-of-sample result anywhere (4/10 within 3x). Reading the flux map here shows which of the six MFT/FFT formation channels the model actually leans on at a reaction-flavour cook temperature.
